title: Test imitation only after an observable expert is validated
doing: Keep observable-expert imitation/DAgger plus PPO separately gated against matched PPO, two training seeds per arm. DODGE-048 now proposes a supervised entity/CNN/grid-token proxy before PPO. The original FullState heuristic and engine oracles are forbidden label sources under the current teacher goal; no separate privileged-label route remains. No demonstration collection, fitting, replay or training is authorized.
expected: An observable short-horizon expert may supply useful action supervision cheaply and improve early survival, but imitation can inherit model errors or plateau at the expert. Information aliasing can prevent matching a fuller-state heuristic; its historical performance is not an attainable guarantee.
next_step: Review the proposed DODGE-048 benchmark, then await explicit source-only expert/architecture implementation approval; later games, fits and PPO need separate authority.
